description: Singapore Police Force Digital Traffic Red Light Cameras is a dataset listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by Singapore Police Force. Digital Traffic Red Light System (DTRLS) consists of SPF wholly owned traffic enforcement cameras deployed at road junctions to deter and detect vehicles from committing the traffic offence of red-running. Implementation approach is in phases. Coverage: Singapore. The portal files it under the publisher Singapore Police Force. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2025-12-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
